items.stem: Which of the following questions is a statistical question?
choices: How tall is the tallest student in the class?
What is the name of your math teacher?
How many students are in your school?
What is the favorite fruit of the students in your class?

items.stem: A teacher asks her students, "How many pets do you have at home?" Which characteristic makes this a statistical question?
choices: It requires a yes or no answer.
It can be answered with one specific number.
It expects different answers from different students.
It asks about a personal preference.

items.stem: Select ALL questions that are statistical questions.
choices: What is the average number of books read by students in the school?
How old is your next-door neighbor?
How many siblings do students in your class have?
What time does the school day start?

items.stem: Explain why the question "What is the favorite sport of students in your grade?" is a statistical question. Show or explain your work.
